description: Minimum grant for the main window. Tauri v2 denies everything not listed here, and this file is deliberately short: Docker is driven from Rust with std::process::Command rather than the shell plugin, and every control-API call is proxied through a typed command, so neither shell execution nor arbitrary HTTP needs to be granted to the webview. Note that opener needs two entries — allow-open-url permits calling the command, while allow-default-urls supplies the http/https scope it is checked against; granting only the first denies every URL at runtime with no error the user can see. This is deliberately not opener:default, which would also grant reveal-item-in-dir that nothing here uses.
